title: fix(core): sort parameters & support client.search for sffv

This is done by updating the helper minimal dependency and thus includes https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/pull/906 and https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/pull/911

**Result**

<!--
  Demonstrate the code is solid.

- parameters are sent sorted, avoiding edge cases where widgets get removed and added again in a different order resulting in missed cache
- supports client.search for searchForFacetValues, simplifying the requirement for searchClient (via https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/5066 in types too later)
